Actual primary-normalization obstruction: no p:O satisfies ramifiedIdeal=span{p} AND lambda² divides p-1. The proof is local to this actual ideal: p and p-1 would both belong to it, forcing1 in a proper ideal. No general lemma is misplaced under this cyclotomic subject.

explicit_premises: The actual restricted quotient reduction rootsOfUnity3O→rootsOfUnity3(O/P) is surjective and defines a multiplicative equivalence. This is not a whole-ring quotient equivalence.
Under the same good maximal hypotheses, actual q=Nat.card(O/P) satisfies3|(q-1), and m=(q-1)/3 is strictly positive.

An actual quotient units homomorphism u↦u^m into quotient cube roots is lifted through the actual restricted inverse to O, then zero-extended using MulChar.ofUnitHom. For every x:O/P, including0, πP(cubicChar(P,hgood)(x))=x^m.

The actual multiplicative character has cube equal to the trivial multiplicative character, is nontrivial and has order3. On units its value has cube1; its value at0 is0, so pointwise cube1 at0 is false.
